title: Ender Mace Mod by Kurzer
description: Ender Mace – a legendary weapon for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric). It deals ~12 damage, has 2500 durability, and unique effects
body:
Macecraft adds the Ender Mace – a legendary weapon (~12 dmg, 2500 durability). 
On hit: 
1) teleport to target, 
2) area damage (+5 in 3.5 blocks)
3) Levitation (1s), Slowness II (3s), Weakness I (2s). 

3) Craftable with Mace, Netherite, Ender Pearls, Eye of Ender, Blaze Rod.
